subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding
stimulus: numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) Out of his frustration, he composed a sonnet "Kopotaksha Nad" in Bengali which earned him huge reputation in Bangla. (b) Afterwards he regretted his fascination for England and the West. (c) Gradually he could realize that his true identity lay in Bangla and he was a sojourner in Europe. (d) They showed his higher level of intellectual ability. (e) He came back to Bangla and devoted himself to Bengali literature from this period. (f) To his utter frustration he found that he was not esteemed as a native writer of English literature. (g) So after adopting Christianity, Madhusudan went to Europe and started composing poems and plays in English. (h) However, he failed to gain the right appreciation. Part−B : Writing Test [50 Marks]
guide_solution: Rearranging 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 g d h f c a e b So after adopting Christianity, Madhusudan went to Europe and started composing poems and plays in English. They showed his higher level of intellectual ability. However, he failed to gain the right appreciation. To his utter frustration he found that he was not esteemed as a native writer of English literature. Gradually he could realize that his true identity lay in Bangla and he was a sojourner in Europe. Out of his frustration, he composed a sonnet "Kopotaksha Nad" in Bengali which earned him huge reputation in Bangla. He came back to Bangla and devoted himself to Bengali literature from this period. Afterwards he regretted his fascination for England and the West. Part−B : Writing Test See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 257
